propositions: A mixed-provider fallback chain disables prompt caching because provider-specific cache keys do not intersect across candidates.
runner_support._intersect_capabilities collapses disagreeing prompt_cache_style values to 'none' for the entire chain.

An operator observing a chain-backed op report cache_read_tokens=0 and cache_write_tokens=0 may incorrectly conclude caching regressed, when it is the intended behavior of fallback capability intersection.
The llm-framework accounting section documentation did not explain why cache counts are zero for fallback chains while the same model called alone caches normally.
docs/llm-framework.md's accounting section now documents fallback chain caching behavior and references runner_support._intersect_capabilities as the authority.
